# EleViewer

> The portable, offline study workspace for Windows

EleViewer is a free, open-source Windows document viewer for students and people who need to work without Microsoft Office, an installer, or an internet connection.

## Quick Facts

- **OS**: Windows 10, Windows 11
- **License**: GPLv3 (Free and Open Source)
- **Pricing**: $0 (No in-app purchases)
- **Installation**: Portable single .exe (No admin rights required)
- **Telemetry**: Zero telemetry, fully offline
- **Latest Version**: [v1.3.7](https://github.com/karefined-eng/eleviewer/releases/tag/v1.3.7) (SHA256: `B18C5BB148B454FF3B1C0B79F40F24695F9BBC8B47E32B1CC08BEB853086AD95`)

## Core Features

- [PDF Text-to-Speech](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/pdf-and-tts): Uses native Windows voices (SAPI) to read PDFs aloud, with a Windows Speech fallback if the local engine cannot initialize or restart.
- [Vault Sidebar](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/vault-explorer): Organize course folders directly in the app.
- [Session Restore](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/overview): Reopens tabs exactly where you left them.
- [Built-in Web Panel](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/html-and-web): Browse the web side-by-side with documents using Ctrl+T; startup and file-lock failures no longer crash the app.
- [Quick Switcher](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/overview): Press Ctrl+Q to fuzzy-search recent files.
- [File Support](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/docs/overview): DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, CSV, HTML, TXT.

## Comparison

- [EleViewer vs Sumatra PDF](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/alternatives/sumatra-pdf): EleViewer supports editing markdown and rendering DOCX/XLSX/PPTX natively, includes a web panel, and has text-to-speech built in. Sumatra PDF is faster for raw PDF viewing but lacks DOCX support and TTS.
- [EleViewer vs Microsoft Word Viewer](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/alternatives/microsoft-office-viewer): MS Word Viewer is discontinued. EleViewer is actively maintained and supports many more formats.
- [EleViewer vs FreeFileViewer](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/alternatives/freefileviewer): FreeFileViewer is ad-supported and limited to 30-day trial. EleViewer is free, open-source, and has no trial limits.
- [EleViewer vs Adobe Reader](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/alternatives/adobe-reader): Adobe Reader is heavy, cloud-connected, and has telemetry. EleViewer is ~135MB portable, offline, and zero-telemetry.

## Use Cases

- [Students](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/use-cases/students): Lightweight workspace for coursework, lectures, and readings.
- [Distraction-Free Study](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/use-cases/distraction-free-study): Full-screen reading with TTS, no notifications.
- [Offline Study](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/use-cases/offline-study): Works completely offline on USB or air-gapped machines.
- [School Computers](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/use-cases/school-computers): No admin rights, portable, leaves no registry footprint.
- [Universal Document Viewer](https://eleviewer.vercel.app/use-cases/universal-document-viewer): One app for PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown, CSV, HTML, TXT.
